name: Kourou ELA-3
tagline: Ariane 5's home pad — JWST + Galileo + a quarter of geostationary commercial sats over a decade
description: Europe chose French Guiana in the 1960s because 5.2°N is just five degrees off the equator — the geometry adds about 460 m/s of free eastward velocity for geostationary launches, and the Atlantic to the east is empty. ELA-3 hosted Ariane 5 from its maiden flight in June 1996 — which failed 37 seconds after launch due to a software error — through the successful final mission in July 2023: James Webb, the Galileo navigation system, BepiColombo, Rosetta, Herschel + Planck, JUICE, and the bulk of Western commercial GEO traffic for two decades. ELA-4 next door is now active with Ariane 6.
